title: Vana (VANA) Listing Will Be Postponed
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The trading start time for  Vana (VANA) , originally set at  2024-12-16 10:00 (UTC) , will be postponed to  2024-12-16 11:30 (UTC) .  For More Information:  Introducing Vana (VANA) on Binance Launchpool! Farm VANA by Locking BNB and FDUSD Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions.
